classification_basis: A finding blocks only when independent reproduction shows a violation of an explicit B-4 acceptance criterion. Accepted scoped limitations are listed separately and are not blockers.

findings.location: scripts/qualification/evol_x_closure_publication_preflight.py:643-672 (_gate_a_pass_record, A-14); docs/project/maintainers/qualification/evol_x/EVOL_X_IIAC_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_PASS_RECORD.md has no -text attribute (.gitattributes only protects iiac_evidence/**)
findings.failure_condition: Gate A compares the working-tree bytes of the pass record to the auditor copy, to the certification-record digest and to the HEAD blob. In a fresh checkout with Git for Windows default core.autocrlf=true the file is materialised with CRLF, so all three comparisons fail. The result depends on checkout configuration, not on evidence.
findings.independent_evidence: Fresh clone of HEAD with default config: git ls-files --eol = i/lf w/crlf; preflight Gate A emits 3x A-14 (differs from auditor copy; digest mismatch; differs from HEAD). The implementer's own test test_canonical_repository_formal_closure_fails_closed_while_b6_unpublished FAILS there: assert {'A-14','A-18'} <= {'A-18'}. With core.autocrlf=false and the file re-checked-out as LF the same clone gives only the two expected A-18 errors. Linux CI would not show it.
findings.required_correction: Make the byte contract checkout-independent: add the pass-record path to .gitattributes with -text (or compare against git blob content normalised identically on both sides) and add a regression test that runs the canonical check in a clone made with core.autocrlf=true.
findings.closure_criteria: Fresh clone with core.autocrlf=true: preflight --gate b6-readiness returns only A-18 errors while blockers are open and the canonical test passes; corrective SHA re-audited.
blocks: B6 admission on any CRLF checkout

findings.failure_condition: A-18 passes when the open_blockers_for_closure entries are absent. Closing the B-4 blocker and the P3-authorisation blocker needs no reference to any independent evidence (re-audit record, digest, SHA, operator authorisation). A missing or null open_blockers_for_closure field is also read as 'no blockers'.
findings.independent_evidence: Isolated clone of the REAL published evidence (certification index re-hashed, nothing else changed): deleting the two lines 'B-4 ...' and 'B6 acceptance (P3) ...' gives Gate A PASS (exit 0 for --gate b6-readiness) with B-5 still open. Rewriting the B-4 line to 'B-4 RESOLVED ...' keeps Gate A FAIL (status text alone does not pass), but deletion does. Synthetic fixture T5e: removing the field entirely gives Gate A PASS.
findings.required_correction: Bind blocker closure to evidence: require a resolved-blockers structure that cites (a) the B-4 re-audit manifest/findings digest produced by independent-quality-auditor with audited SHA = the corrective implementation SHA (descendant check), and (b) an operator-attested P3 authorisation artefact with signature line and digest, both verified by Gate A. Make open_blockers_for_closure a required list (missing/null = FAIL).
findings.closure_criteria: Fixtures: blocker lines deleted without evidence reference -> Gate A FAIL; with a valid reference -> PASS; forged/mismatched reference -> FAIL; missing field -> FAIL.
blocks: B-4 acceptance (explicit criterion: closure needs an independent evidence reference)

findings.failure_condition: Any status text that contains SIGNED, APPROVED or CONFIRMED and a date is treated as a recorded decision, including negated or revoked ones.
findings.independent_evidence: decision_recorded(status, '2026-11-06') returns True for 'NOT APPROVED', 'NOT CONFIRMED', 'REVOKED (previously APPROVED)', 'REJECTED - not approved', 'APPROVED - WITHDRAWN', 'CONFIRMED? NO'; False only for 'UNSIGNED', PENDING, DRAFT, 'NOT SIGNED'. An operator who declines OD-EVOL-12 or OD-EVOLX-08 with the natural wording 'NOT APPROVED' would satisfy B-07.
findings.required_correction: Use an allow-list of affirmative status tokens (SIGNED / APPROVED, OPERATOR APPROVED, CONFIRMED) matched at the start of the normalised status, and a deny-list of NOT, NO, REVOKED, WITHDRAWN, REJECTED, DECLINED, SUPERSEDED, DENIED anywhere. Add negative tests for each.
findings.closure_criteria: All listed negated/revoked wordings fail B-07; real register rows (SIGNED / APPROVED, OPERATOR APPROVED, ...) still pass.

findings.failure_condition: Gate B accepts 'genuine published B6 acceptance' on three self-asserted flags (governance formal_b6_status=ACCEPTED, b6_acceptance_policy_version, certification record b6_acceptance=ISSUED) plus a commit whose governance JSON carries the flag. No acceptance record, operator signature line, certifier session id or digest is required or verified; the flags can be set by any committer.
findings.independent_evidence: Synthetic fixture G6: flags flipped in one commit by an arbitrary actor, blockers cleared, FRZ rows and register edited -> Gate A PASS and Gate B PASS with no authorisation artefact referenced. Contrast with A-16, which does require an operator-attested handoff for the audit sessions.
findings.required_correction: Require a P3 B6 acceptance record (path, SHA-256 digest in the certification record, operator signature line with ISO timestamp, certifier session id matching the manifest) published at B6_ACCEPTANCE_PUBLICATION_SHA and verify it in B-01..B-04. This is the same artefact class recommended for RA-B4-02(b).
findings.closure_criteria: Fixture with flags only -> Gate B FAIL; fixture with valid acceptance record at the B6 SHA -> PASS; digest/signature/session mismatch -> FAIL.

findings.location: preflight A-07/A-08 (startswith + phrase presence), A-17 (verdict prefix), B-06 (phrase presence in FRZ rows)
findings.failure_condition: Required phrases are checked for presence, never for absence of a contradicting claim. The certified-limitation check allows arbitrary appended text because it only requires the auditor text as prefix. Certifier-authored limitations (LIM-08..LIM-10, F-C-01, F-C-02, the evidence-only line) and the certified manifest are not compared with the bytes published at certification_publication_sha, so they can be altered or dropped after P2.
findings.independent_evidence: Real-evidence clone, blockers removed so only scope checks decide: appending 'platform-wide test ownership is established' to LIM-03, 'production ActivationService.rollback enforcement is in force' to LIM-05, 'M-09H was measured' to LIM-02, 'M-03 generalises' to LIM-04, appending 'production rollback enforcement IS claimed' to the FRZ-EVOL-07 disposition, rewriting FRZ-EVOL-01 to '...unrestricted ownership', and setting certification_verdict to PASS_SCOPED_UNRESTRICTED_PLATFORM_WIDE all keep Gate A PASS. Gate B fixtures G9-G11: FRZ-07/-08/-01 rows contradicting the scope but retaining the tokens pass Gate B. Fixture M1: dropping every certifier-authored limitation after P2 keeps Gate A PASS.
findings.determination: Not a bypass of independent authority: the auditor draft, pass record and dossier stay digest-bound and the original restrictions stay present as prefix, so a contradiction is visible to a reader. It is the documented limitation R-1 of the handoff, with the consequence that gate PASS must never be read as semantic confirmation of scope. The post-publication mutability part is a cheap, deterministic gap.
findings.required_correction: Recommended in the same corrective cycle: (1) require manifest limitations/verdict/session ids at HEAD to equal the blob at certification_publication_sha (immutability, no text matching needed); (2) deny-list of widening tokens in limitations, dispositions, FRZ rows (platform-wide, unrestricted, is claimed, enforcement is in force, was measured); (3) mandatory recorded human semantic review of FRZ row text and limitations in the P4 publication.
findings.closure_criteria: (1) and (2) covered by negative fixtures; (3) recorded in the certifier P4 checklist.

findings.failure_condition: JSON output carries no repository class (canonical vs fixture) and exit code 0 is returned for any --repo. Only the text report labels FIXTURE.
findings.independent_evidence: Code reading; fixtures in the B-4 tests use exactly this path.
findings.required_correction: Add repository_class to JSON, and return a non-zero exit code for non-canonical repositories unless an explicit --fixture flag is passed.

findings.failure_condition: Prefix test is purely textual: a path with '..' segments would be reported exempt. Git never emits such paths, so the gates cannot receive one. The exemption covers every .py under iiac_evidence/, not only the 7 probes.
findings.independent_evidence: split_ruff_exempt on 12 probe paths: only iiac_evidence/** paths are exempt; iiac_evidence_x/, iiac_evidence.py, IIAC_EVIDENCE/, evol_x/misplaced_probe.py, scripts/** are linted. Staged-file simulation of both gates: evidence probe exempt, misplaced file linted. ruff directory discovery excludes the evidence root and still flags the misplaced file.
findings.required_correction: None required; optional posixpath.normpath before matching.

findings.failure_condition: Legacy (policy not IN_FORCE) mode always contains L-00, so it can never pass either gate. Fail-closed; the handoff phrase 'legacy path kept' means kept as a diagnostic only.
findings.independent_evidence: Activation record committed as NOT_IN_FORCE or with status removed -> mode LEGACY, A/B FAIL, no downgrade path.
findings.required_correction: None; document that legacy is diagnostic-only.

findings.failure_condition: A separate legacy verifier still requires a named OD-EVOL-11 human auditor. It is not called by the closure preflight and not wired to CI.
findings.independent_evidence: grep: no workflow or script references closure preflight; the verifier states it does not sign B6.
findings.required_correction: Decide separately whether it is retired or migrated; not a B-4 item.

findings.failure_condition: Gate B implements nine controls (B-00 prerequisite, B-01..B-04, B-06..B-10); no B-05 exists. The documented range B-01..B-10 implies ten.
findings.independent_evidence: grep 'B-05' in the preflight, its tests and the handoff: only the unrelated certifier blocker id 'B-5'. All requirement areas of Gate B (Gate A, published B6, two-phase SHA, certification record, FRZ dispositions, operator decisions, ladder, blockers, scope restrictions) are covered by the existing controls.
findings.required_correction: Renumber or document the gap in the corrective.

findings.failure_condition: Assertions encode the pre-activation state (canonical status NOT_IN_FORCE; no *IIAC_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_PASS_RECORD.md anywhere). IIAC activation (f8c29fb8...) and the P1/P2 publications legitimately changed that state. The four tests fail identically at baseline and at HEAD.
findings.independent_evidence: Reproduced in clones at ca2b14782 and 9a8fa3634: 4 failed in both, identical assertion text. CI run 42104326792 (HEAD) governance-fast: 6 failed, 120 passed.
findings.required_correction: Separate governance test-hotfix ticket (spec delivered). Not part of B-4.

findings.failure_condition: The tests overwrite canonical files and restore them with Path.write_text, which translates LF to CRLF on Windows. IIAC_POLICY_ACTIVATION_RECORD.json is -text, so the restored file no longer matches its blob and the activation gate fails until git checkout. OD_ENT_02_THREAT_MODEL.md is rewritten the same way.
findings.independent_evidence: In a clone, running the file left the activation blob at c067ebc4... instead of c505dd5b...; verify_iiac_policy_activation then failed with 'worktree activation record does not match HEAD' and the EVOL-X preflight mode became INVALID (A-01). Restored with git checkout. The canonical repository was never exposed: the blob stayed c505dd5b... after every canonical-repo test run.
findings.required_correction: Tests must operate on copies in tmp_path or write bytes (write_bytes) and restore the original bytes.

findings.failure_condition: tests/unit/governance/test_iiac_g0_inventory.py (2 tests) fail in CI with 'not ancestor of HEAD' / 'bad object': the activation and G0 checks need history that a depth-1 checkout lacks. They pass locally (G0 PASS, 17510 paths).
findings.independent_evidence: gh run view 42104326792 --log-failed; local verify_iiac_g0_inventory_completeness PASS. Not runnable at baseline in CI (no run exists for ca2b14782), inferred from the failing messages which reference pre-B-4 commits.
findings.required_correction: fetch-depth: 0 for governance-fast, in the hotfix ticket.
